title: Accu-Chek Combo Unable to pair
symptom: After changing phone to Android 15, the user cannot pair the Accu-Chek Combo pump with AAPS 3.3.0DEV. They tried disabling full-screen notification display but still no effect.
cause: The user suspects that the full-screen display of the prompt selection window caused AAPS to misunderstand and quit, leading to pairing failure.
evidence_quote: It should be that the window was full-screen when the scan was visible in advance, which led to AAPS misunderstanding and quit.
